name: Hosa Aba
description: Hosa Aba (meaning 'Trousers Down') is the Swiss-German variant of the popular European banking game 'Schwimmen' or '31'. It is a fast-paced game of card swapping where players aim to collect cards of a single suit totaling 31 points (Hosa Aba). It is traditionally played with Swiss-German suited cards in the German-speaking cantons of Switzerland.

content.text: Hosa Aba (meaning 'Trousers Down') is the Swiss-German variant of the popular European banking game 'Schwimmen' or '31'. It is a fast-paced game of card swapping where players aim to collect cards of a single suit totaling 31 points (Hosa Aba). It is traditionally played with Swiss-German suited cards in the German-speaking cantons of Switzerland.
Part of the extensive family of 'Thirty-One' games that have existed in Europe since the 15th century. Hosa Aba specifically refers to the localized Swiss version with its unique terminology.
36-card Swiss-German deck (6-10, Under, Ober, King, Ace).
